intent: Everyone runs noticeably faster and the moving platforms glide 25% faster, so climbing the tower is quicker but riding platforms demands tighter timing.
accept: Player run speed is 25% higher than before (8 -> 10 px/tick)
Gates, determinism test and bots still pass; the tower remains climbable

criteria.text: Player run speed is 25% higher than before (8 -> 10 px/tick)
criteria.evidence: diff: config.ts runSpeed 8 -> 10. after/shot-2 shows no visible difference in motion.
diff: config.ts movingPlatformSpeed 2.5 -> 3.125. No moving platform is distinguishable in any after shot.

criteria.text: Gates, determinism test and bots still pass; the tower remains climbable
criteria.evidence: after/shot-2: bots climb (bot9 at 17m vs best 13m before). The preview ocr gate failed; I could not confirm it is unrelated.

findings: The change is a pure number tweak (runSpeed, movingPlatformSpeed in packages/games/template/config.ts). A viewer cannot tell the after clip from the before clip, since before/after shots look the same apart from bot positions. Add something visible, for example a speed-trail or dust effect in assets.ts that scales with player speed, or a rule in rules.ts that gives a visible speed burst on landing
Make the effect noticeable to players: a 25% speed change is below perception. Consider a larger change or a new mechanic (for example a dash with a visible trail) in rules.ts with a test.
Check why the preview ocr gate failed and make sure it is not caused by this change.
